claims.text: The hotel sits on Marbella's Golden Mile in Southern Spain, steps from the sandy beaches of the Mediterranean.

findings.quote: Located on the exclusive Golden Mile in Southern Spain, our hotel is steps from the sandy beaches and turquoise waters of the Mediterranean.

claims.text: The hotel is part of the Puente Romano resort.

findings.quote:
The brand’s Spanish outpost forms part of the sprawling
Puente Romano resort

claims.text: The hotel pairs Andalusian charm with Nobu's signature Japanese aesthetic.

findings.quote: Costa del Sol sunshine and Andalusian charm meet Nobu’s signature Japanese aesthetic

claims.text: Rooms have brown marble bathrooms, minimal lines and lots of wood, with linen furnishings.

findings.quote: with Eastern-leaning brown marble bathrooms, minimal lines and lots of wood, while linen furnishings and a scattering of cushions bring you back to the Med.

claims.text: Rooms come with Japanese yukata robes.

findings.quote: Japanese yukata robes

claims.text: The spa's hammam has herbal and regular steam rooms, a sauna, hot-and-cold therapy showers and various hydrotherapy pools.

findings.quote: with herbal and regular steam rooms and sauna, hot-and-cold therapy showers, and various hydrotherapy pools

claims.text: The fitness facility has Technogym equipment and a private studio for spin, barre and boxing classes.

findings.quote: Discover a private health sanctuary featuring Technogym equipment and a private studio for spin, barre, and boxing classes.

claims.text: The hotel offers daily complimentary classes, including yoga and Pilates.

findings.quote: Our daily complimentary classes , including yoga and Pilates

claims.text: Nobu Marbella serves signature dishes, including Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Sashimi, at a sushi bar, in the dining room or on a terrace overlooking La Plaza.

findings.quote: Enjoy signature dishes, including Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Sashimi
at the intimate sushi bar, in the minimalist elegance of the dining room, or on the Nobu Terrace overlooking La Plaza.

claims.text: Guests have access to La Plaza, a fine dining and nightlife scene set along the Mediterranean.

findings.quote: Guests will also enjoy access to La Plaza, the city’s fine dining and nightlife scene set along the Mediterranean Sea.

claims.text: Service follows Omotenashi, the Japanese spirit of hospitality.

findings.quote: Thoughtful, attentive service infused with Omotenashi, the Japanese spirit of hospitality.

claims.text: The hotel welcomes pets.

findings.quote: Yes, we warmly welcome pets.

claims.text: Six Senses Spa offers treatments in traditional treatment rooms, canopied cabana rooms, or by the sea.

findings.quote: Six Senses Spa offers a holistic approach to wellness and a distinct Mediterranean healing experience in traditional treatment rooms, breezy canopied cabana rooms, or by the sea with stunning views.

claims.text: Nobu Pool is an adults-only pool reserved for hotel guests.

findings.quote: Nobu Pool, the sophisticated, adults-only retreat that’s exclusively for our guests.

claims.text: The resort's tennis club has 8 clay courts, 2 plexipave courts and 4 padel courts, with coaching sessions with a pro and matches with other guests.

findings.quote: The facilities boast 8 clay courts, 2 plexipave courts, and 4 Padel courts.
the resort’s tennis club, a favourite with stars of the game, is the place for a coaching session with a pro, lively mix-ins with other guests

claims.text: Balconies look over the resort's rooftops or, in some rooms, across the sea.

findings.quote: Balconies showcase views over the resort’s rooftops or, if you’re lucky, across the sea.

claims.text: La Casita Kids Club runs a daily activities program, including tennis coaching, art masterclasses and cooking lessons, including Nobu sushi workshops.

findings.quote: La Casita Kids Club runs a daily activities program, including tennis coaching, art masterclasses, and cooking lessons (including Nobu sushi workshops)

claims.text: There are some ramps throughout the resort, but many rooms are reached by stairs alone.

findings.quote: There are some ramps throughout the resort, but a lot of rooms are only accessible via stairs.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler advises booking spa treatments in advance.

findings.quote: Book spa treatments in advance to avoid disappointment

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited availability during the peak summer season.
